0022600180.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3, 1-2 on the road) in the Thunder's eighth game of the 2026-27 season. The Thunder are currently on a one-game winning streak and sit 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, while the Cavaliers, who have lost their last game, are 2nd in the Central, 2 games back. Thunder players Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee) are out, and Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness). Oklahoma City leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 117-112 win in Cleveland on November 2.
